serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
There’s a few people here, but not too many.
No cameras either.
If I were to pick a place for such activity I would pick this bar.
Which one of them is the Admin though?
As I stand there, one of them turns around and stares at me for a second. {{wi}}Was that a sign?
I guess so, no one else seemed to even notice me. I will just ask him.
You: H-hey, are you waiting for someone?
???: Yeah. 
You: I was supposed to meet someone here…
You: Are you Admin?
Admin: Yeah, that’s me. 
Admin: I’m happy to finally meet you,
That’s the Admin? He seems like a normal guy. An accountant? There’s a pair of glasses sitting on his nose.
He looks rather skinny and I can’t help but to feel a little disappointed.
Now that I stand in front of him, he seems rather out of place in this bar.
No one else seems to bother. Maybe he’s a regular?
Admin: Please, sit. We have a lot to talk about.
You: Sure…
Admin: I know that you were just recently recruited to our organization, but I must commend your courage for coming here.
You: Thanks…
Admin: Now that I think about it, I never had a chance to ask you for your motivation.
Hmmm… 
What should I say to him?
I guess there’s no point in lying. I will just answer honestly.
